title: backlog.py set applies its options to several items in one call, so putting items in a sprint is one write
goal: set ID ID... --sprint SP applies the options to every id with one --commit for the batch; an id the set refuses leaves every item unchanged; with several ids set refuses --title, --goal, --notes, --repro, --repro-reason, --parent, --clause and --check, which name one item; the sprint skill's plan step 2 puts items in a sprint with one set call

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init","-q");(r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items","scratch_dir":"_cache/scratch"}));(r/"items").mkdir()
def item(i,**k):
 d=dict(id=i,kind="story",title="t",status="todo",priority="P3",goal="g",touches=["x.txt"],checks=[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}]);d.update(k)
 (r/"items"/(i+".json")).write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+"\n")
def commit():g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","i")
env=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="chk");env.pop("KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG",None)
def run(*a):return s.run([sys.executable,T,"--root",str(r),*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env)
(r/"items"/"SP-cccccccc.json").write_text(json.dumps({"id":"SP-cccccccc","kind":"sprint","title":"s","status":"planned","goal":"g"}))
for i in ("ST-aaaaaaaa","ST-bbbbbbbb","ST-dddddddd"):item(i,status="draft")
commit()
sp=lambda i:json.loads((r/"items"/(i+".json")).read_text()).get("sprint")
a=run("set","ST-aaaaaaaa","ST-bbbbbbbb","--sprint","SP-cccccccc");b=run("set","ST-dddddddd","ST-nosuch01","--sprint","SP-cccccccc")
print(a.returncode,b.returncode,(a.stdout+a.stderr)[-200:],sp("ST-aaaaaaaa"),sp("ST-bbbbbbbb"),sp("ST-dddddddd"))
ok=a.returncode==0 and sp("ST-aaaaaaaa")=="SP-cccccccc" and sp("ST-bbbbbbbb")=="SP-cccccccc"
sys.exit(0 if ok and b.returncode!=0 and sp("ST-dddddddd") is None else 1)
